recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, soft-focus profile portrait of a man with feathered hair and aviator glasses, bathed in warm, golden-brown sepia tones with a hazy, dreamlike atmosphere and elegant serif typography in the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm sepia tones unify the subject and background
Soft-focus lighting creates a halo effect around the hair
Right-aligned typography balances the left-facing profile
High-key highlights on the collar contrast with deep shadows in the background
coreInvariants: Monochromatic warm color palette (browns, golds, ochres)
Profile or three-quarter view of the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile occupying the center and left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eye and the bridge of the aviator glasses.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's gaze at the bottom left, up through the feathered hair to the text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep brown shadow area on the far left and a hazy golden area on the far right.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm brown and sepia tones for skin, hair, and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Creamy white for the shirt collar and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow for the text and hair highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a focus on tonal gradations; high value in the highlights against deep shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying weights or sizes.
graphicDevices: Subtle corner logos or technical metadata blocks

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 1970s interpretation of classical serifs.
Provides the necessary weight and traditional feel.
A safe fallback for a clean, professional serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus, 1970s-style analog film portrait of a man with feathered hair and aviator glasses in profile. Use a warm sepia and golden-brown color palette with hazy lighting and deep shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of all-caps serif text in the top right corner, right-aligned, in a pale gold color. Ensure the text is clean and legible against the hazy background.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly warm and sepia-toned?
Is the lighting soft and diffused?
Is the typography a classical serif in all-caps?
Is the text right-aligned in the top right corner?

adjustableVariables: Subject's specific features (hair length, glasses style)
mustRedesign: Exact photographic likeness of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for authentic film grain texture.
Ensure the halo effect around the hair is present.
Verify the typography does not overlap the subject's face.
Confirm the overall mood is contemplative and warm.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-focus, warm-toned analog portrait with minimalist, right-aligned serif typography to create a nostalgic 1970s aesthetic.
